blocks.text:
To: Elizabeth Horne
Cc: David Sherman, Jeffrey Ochoa

This note opens our working thread for the {{fact:f:E-2016-001.client}} pension valuation. We have started. David Sherman is reconstructing the participant census from the file your office sent last week, and Jeffrey Ochoa is setting up the valuation model.

Two items from your side will keep us on schedule. We need your confirmation that the plan provisions we are to value match the current plan document at Howard and Sons, and the most recent asset statement whenever it is to hand. Neither is urgent this week.
Please keep this thread as our record for the data and the assumptions. Questions sent here reach the whole team at once.
